# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta10

## Changed

- Make the **Maa- ja Ruumiamet Ortofoto** underlay zoom-aware instead of permanently enlarging the same zoom-18 raster tiles.
- Keep the existing official `foto@GMC` zoom-18 TMS tiles as the fast base/fallback layer, then request a fresh high-resolution `EESTIFOTO` WMS image for the currently visible map area after the user zooms in.
- Refresh the detailed orthophoto after mouse-wheel, pinch or pan activity settles, with a short debounce so normal map interaction does not continuously issue image requests.
- Size detailed WMS requests from the actual card display size and browser pixel density, capped to a bounded image size.
- Keep the previous detailed image visible until its replacement has loaded successfully. If the WMS detail request fails, the existing orthophoto base remains visible.
- Apply the same detailed orthophoto behavior to both single-mower and Multi mower site views.

## Georeference

- Replace the map-card underlay's old fixed-radius spherical local-X/Y ↔ WGS84 helper with WGS84 ellipsoid curvature math, matching the geodesy model now used by Navimower `0.4.4-beta18`.
- This changes only geographic placement of external map underlays; mower-local geometry, trails, zones, station placement and mower coordinates are not modified.

## Compatibility

- The detailed layer uses Maa- ja Ruumiamet's public WGS84 `alus-geo` WMS with `EESTIFOTO`; no API key or additional Home Assistant configuration is required.
- OpenStreetMap underlay behavior is unchanged.
- Estonian orthophoto remains available only for an Estonian site and continues to fall back to the working zoom-18 TMS layer.
- Existing cards continue to default to no map underlay unless one is selected.

## Testing requested

- With **Maa- ja Ruumiamet Ortofoto** selected, compare the normal property view with one or more zoom steps inward. Fine building edges, paths and lawn detail should sharpen after a brief delay instead of only becoming larger pixels.
- Test mouse-wheel zoom and pan on desktop and pinch/drag on mobile.
- Test both single-mower and Multi mower views.
- Confirm that zooming and panning remain smooth and that a temporary WMS failure does not blank the orthophoto.
